name: Elixir
summary: Dynamic functional language on the Erlang VM (BEAM) with Erlang's actor-style processes and OTP, a macro system based on quoted expressions, protocols for polymorphism, and a gradual set-theoretic type system being added incrementally.

level_notes.0: There is one implementation: elixir-lang/elixir. The bootstrap compiler is written in Erlang (lib/elixir/src: tokenizer, yecc grammar, expander, translation to Erlang abstract format) and the rest of the language (Kernel macros, type checker, standard library, Mix, ExUnit, IEx) in Elixir itself. Execution relies on erlang/otp (BEAM emulator, scheduler, per-process GC), so key OTP files are linked too.
level_notes.1: No formal specification or standard exists; the reference implementation and its versioned documentation on hexdocs.pm (Syntax reference, Operators, Patterns and guards, Typespecs, Kernel.SpecialForms) define the language. Language changes are proposed on the elixir-lang-core mailing list rather than through numbered RFCs. hexdocs.pm/elixir/* currently redirects to elixir.hexdocs.pm/*.
